Issue #90 stores only allocator_work_item_id, not allocator_issue_number/actor/chat_id/run_id/fencing_token/allocated_at_utc. steps.validation_note: Canonical allocator is Issue #11 / WI-GOAL-ALLOCATOR-001. New Work Item Issues above legacy cutoff #90 require an allocation_provenance object containing allocator_work_item_id, allocator_issue_number, actor, chat_id, run_id, fencing_token, branch (nullable for branchless allocator), and allocated_at_utc. All fields must exactly match an active coordination:work-item-allocation lease; allocated_at_utc must fall within the lease and within five minutes of GitHub issue.created_at. No owner bypass: owner-created Work Items also require allocator provenance. Issues #1-#90 are grandfathered as legacy; no retroactive blocking. A successful open-event validation is recorded immutably in registry history and must match the live Issue spec for later claims; missing/mismatched/expired provenance fails closed. One chat_id may own only one active lease globally, even across disjoint resources; distinct chats may claim disjoint resources, while same-resource conflicts remain denied. Same-chat rejection occurs before fencing-token increment or lock mutation.
